summary: This Form 6-K reports the distribution of a management information circular and related materials for The Real Brokerage Inc.'s 2026 Annual General Meeting scheduled for May 29, 2026. The meeting agenda includes routine items: receiving audited financials, fixing the board at nine directors, electing directors, and reappointing auditors. No special-situation event is present. The filing is a routine proxy circular notice, not an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or any other special situation as defined.
